# Framewright

> Independent AI-assisted video production studio and research lab by Anton Biletskiy-Volokh.

Films, explainers and product stories; creative tools evaluated in real productions; reusable video methods. Human review guides selection and corrections. Framewright is an author-led studio and an open methods library, not a self-service production app or automatic social publisher.

## Main pages
- [Studio, selected work and contact](https://markoblogo.github.io/framewright/): Canonical public landing page.
- [About and scope](https://markoblogo.github.io/framewright/#about): Services, licences and current limits.
- [Open-source repository](https://github.com/markoblogo/framewright): Methods and documentation under MIT; external tools, models and media retain their own licences.
- [Start a project](https://github.com/markoblogo/framewright/blob/main/docs/start-here.md): Planning, review and continuation.
- [Production cases](https://github.com/markoblogo/framewright/tree/main/docs/productions): Sources, revisions and known limits.
- [Studio Notes](https://markoblogo.github.io/framewright/#studio-notes): Published production lessons on ABVX.
- [Public evidence](https://github.com/markoblogo/framewright/blob/main/docs/public-evidence.json): One story per film; trials include partial and failed attempts. Review entries include untested candidates.
- [Releases](https://github.com/markoblogo/framewright/releases): Consult current release notes and limitations.
- [Author](https://abvx.xyz/): Anton Biletskiy-Volokh.

## Contact
Public enquiries: a.biletskiy@gmail.com. The landing form opens an email draft; the website does not send or store enquiries.
